# Contributing to SafeRoute AI

Thank you for considering contributing to SafeRoute AI! We welcome contributions from the community.

## How to Contribute

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a new branch for your feature or bugfix
3. Make your changes
4. Ensure any tests pass
5. Submit a pull request

## Reporting Issues

Please use the GitHub issue tracker to report bugs or request features.

## Code Style

Please follow the existing code style in the project. We use [EditorConfig](https://editorconfig.org/) to help maintain consistent coding styles.

## Development Setup

See the [README](./docs/product/README.md) for development setup instructions.
